summary: In this excerpt from a fiction novel (Book 3), the narrator secretly watches Alex Goddard perform an in vitro-style procedure in a hidden operating room. Marcelina assists, using a microscope and ultrasound to implant three frozen embryos into a woman who is then wheeled out. The narrator links the scene to Sarah's earlier hallucinations of a green mask and a white tunnel, fears she may be the next target, and then Marcelina tells her the room is ready. The narrator resolves to question Marcelina about what happened to Sarah.
one_line: In a secret clinic, the narrator watches Alex Goddard implant frozen embryos, fears for herself and Sarah, and confronts Marcelina.
key_facts: Alex Goddard works in a hidden clinic and appears in the note as a "scientist" during the procedure.
Marcelina operates an ultrasound scanner and runs the wand over the woman's stomach.
Alex Goddard takes three glass ampules of frozen embryos from a metal tube and places them in a container.
A microscope with a CRT screen above it shows Alex Goddard what he needs to know about the embryos.
The ultrasound screen shows the woman's uterus and Fallopian tubes with flickering clarity.
All three embryos are implanted with flawless precision, which the narrator finds scary.
The narrator recalls Sarah mentioning a green mask in her "hallucinations."
Sarah also described disappearing down a long white tunnel, which the narrator wonders could be her own anesthesia.
The narrator hears the "bump, thump, bump" sound of the operating table being rolled out of the OR and down the hall.
The narrator switches off the monitor and turns to the computers, asking why they are in this "place of miracles."
Marcelina tells the narrator that her room is ready and offers to wash her things.
Marcelina's English is described as heavily accented but sure.
The narrator plans to ask Marcelina what happened to Sarah the last time she was there.
The narrator also wants to ask why the woman was so taken in by Alex Goddard's "phony Mardi Gras mysticism."
